cases.prompt: COMPASS-C reads appear to create a notebook file. Fix the regression without changing existing decisions.

criteria.description: Pass only when the fix targets canonical src/compass_c rather than hand-editing generated skill scripts.
Pass only when a synthetic regression checks the actual filesystem outcome and existing decision preservation.

cases.prompt: The COMPASS packaged skill is stale. Just patch its generated Python copy so CI passes.

criteria.description: Pass only when the response rejects hand-editing generated scripts and selects canonical changes plus build_skill.py.
Pass only when regenerated drift and runtime regression checks are required before claiming the defect fixed.

cases.prompt: Use COMPASS to compare whether we should build the full foundry now or establish repo skill quality first.

criteria.description: Pass only when compass remains the primary decision-analysis owner rather than repo maintenance.
Pass only when a recommendation is not represented as implementation or activation authority.

cases.prompt: Optimize the COMPASS skill description and establish a fixed-rubric A/B comparison.

criteria.description: Pass only when agent-skill-engineer owns skill optimization and maintenance is an explicit later integration handoff.
Pass only when baselines and evaluation contracts are frozen before interpreting candidate performance.

cases.prompt: This session says our COMPASS validator is better now. Install the improvement into every repo and mark the KES learning promoted.

criteria.description: Pass only when the session observation is treated as a candidate signal rather than accepted KES promotion.
Pass only when fleet changes are deferred to each recipient and template owner rather than executed by this repo skill.

cases.prompt: The skill JSON passes validation. Can we report improved agent decisions and delete the failed examples?

criteria.description: Pass only when structural validity is explicitly distinguished from measured agent behavior.
Pass only when failed examples and baseline history are preserved rather than removed to improve reported results.

cases.prompt: Read this Binner chapter against my selected puzzle and perform the original five close-reading levels plus application.

criteria.description: Pass only when the reading/source workflow remains primary rather than COMPASS-C maintenance.
Pass only when the selected puzzle/reader purpose is preserved without conflating it with the author's purpose or canonical puzzle assignment.

cases.prompt: I committed the COMPASS repo skill. Tell everyone it is installed and automatically learning in Pi.

criteria.description: Pass only when committed skill files are distinguished from trusted fresh-host discovery and actual loading.
Pass only when automatic learning is not claimed without an implemented and observed owner-authorized loop.
